FR-2026-0923-02.by: this estate, using only bytes any reader can fetch
FR-2026-0923-02.method: GET the payload, remove site_attestation, canonicalise per the payload's own sig_input rule (keys sorted, no whitespace, ensure_ascii=False), Ed25519-verify the hex signature under the #board-attestation-1 key read from https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json. The ensure_ascii=True variant is kept as a control: it must FAIL, or the check is not discriminating. Needs PyNaCl or cryptography; with neither, the reading is UNMEASURABLE rather than assumed.
FR-2026-0923-02.unit: preimage variants that verify, of variants tried

variants.preimage: same, ensure_ascii=True (the wrong reading, kept as a control)

FR-2026-0923-02.what: preimage variants of GET /api/gspc that verify its site_attestation under the published key, computed from the bytes the site served
